title: The note about other categories on a category's page
stem: Where should "The [matrix] matrix also prices [n] other categories: [A] · [B]." appear?

options.t: As a line above the grid, as the category page requirement says
options.why: it is the requirement written for this page

options.t: In an info-icon tooltip beside the matrix name, with no line, as the design draws

context: The category page requirement puts the sentence on a line above the grid. Elsewhere the PRD says new pages show no explanatory text and put explanations in info-icon tooltips, which is what the design does here.
where: PRD Story 7 (a category's page) and Story 19 (explanations in tooltips); Tiered Pricing design canvas, picture 7.9
